empty.title: Say hello to MIA
empty.text: Ask a question, tell her about your day, or try one of these:
about.title: MIA
about.text: MIA is not an assistant. This chat page shows MIA and her 3D character. Everything runs on your own machine; the page loads nothing from the internet.
chat.sending_failed: The message could not be sent.
pipeline.summary: How I got there · {n} steps · {s} s
character.unavailable: The 3D character could not be loaded. The chat works without it.
settings.title: Settings
settings.enter.auto: Sends on computers, new line on touch screens
settings.enter.newline: Always a new line (use the send button)
settings.token.hint: Needed once per device to change expressions in the expression editor. The editor reads it from here.
login.title: Log in
login.visible: Everything here is visible to all users of this MIA: the conversation, her memory, the workflows and every change with its author.
login.throttled: Too many tries. Please wait a minute.
login.insecure: A password is only sent over HTTPS or on this computer (localhost). Open the page over HTTPS.
login.empty: Please enter your account and your password.
login.failed: The login did not work. Is MIA reachable?
chat.how_empty: No account of the steps was kept.
chat.queue_full: The queue is full: wait for an answer.
variant.label: Outfit: {name}
workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.hint: Shared by all users: everybody sees and may change everything here.
workspace.source: Source (where does she know this from?)
workspace.trust_range: A trust value is a number from 0 to 1.
workspace.trust_hint: How much MIA trusts a kind of source before she reads it (0 = not at all, 1 = fully).
workspace.persona_hint: The persona file she follows: names, form of address, manner. The change applies to everybody.
workspace.changed_elsewhere: Somebody else changed this. Close and open the workspace to see it.

account.empty: Please enter your current and your new password.
account.short: The new password needs at least 8 characters.
account.mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same.
account.same: The new password must differ from the current one.
